description: Per-line VAT (gap-analysis Section 5A item 8). cartStore.getVatAmount currently applies a flat 7% on (subtotal - discount) and ignores each product's vatIncluded/vatRate. Compute VAT per cart line from the line product's flags and sum, keeping totals correct (inclusive lines must not double-add VAT). Update PaymentScreen's VAT display and prove with a vitest. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003.
steps: Rework src/store/cartStore.ts getVatAmount: for each cart line compute lineNet = line subtotal after its item discount, proportionally reduced by the bill-level discount (so sum(lineNet) = getSubtotal() - getDiscountTotal()); then per line using product.vatIncluded/product.vatRate (rate 0 or 7): exclusive VAT = lineNet * rate/100; inclusive VAT = lineNet - lineNet/(1 + rate/100); rate 0 contributes 0. Sum across lines. Ensure getGrandTotal stays correct: inclusive items keep current grand total (VAT embedded), exclusive items are reflected consistently with how PaymentScreen builds the payable total — verify against PaymentScreen before changing grand-total semantics; if grand total currently excludes exclusive VAT, document and keep behaviour unless the test requires otherwise.

Update src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx: the summary row hardcodes 'VAT 7% (รวมแล้ว)'. Make the label honour mixed/real VAT (e.g. plain 'ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม (VAT)' or compute whether all lines are inclusive) so it no longer asserts a flat 7% inclusive when lines differ. Keep Thai text and existing layout/tokens.

Add vitest src/store/__tests__/cartVat.test.ts: build a cart with an inclusive-7% line, an exclusive-7% line, and a 0% line; assert getVatAmount equals the hand-computed sum; assert grand total is unchanged for the inclusive line and correctly reflects the exclusive line; include a case with a bill-level discount applied. Drive cartStore via its actions (addItem/updateItemDiscount/setDiscount) or by seeding items; follow vitest patterns already in the repo.
Run tsc + tests; confirm the existing 14 cartAdapter tests and engine 39/0 do not regress.
acceptance_criteria: getVatAmount returns the per-line sum (inclusive vs exclusive vs 0%) rather than a flat 7% on the discounted subtotal.
Inclusive lines do not double-add VAT; grand total remains consistent.
PaymentScreen no longer displays a hardcoded 'VAT 7% (รวมแล้ว)' when lines are not all inclusive-7%.
New cartVat vitest suite passes; cartAdapter 14/14 and engine 39/0 unchanged.
No new tsc errors in cartStore.ts or PaymentScreen.tsx.

cd d:\pos-mobile\.worktrees\pricing-fix ; npx tsc --noEmit  (no new errors in touched files)
findings: GRAND-TOTAL SEMANTICS (verified against PaymentScreen/Receipt/CartScreen before changing): getGrandTotal previously returned subtotal-discount with NO VAT added, and every screen displays getVatAmount as an informational 'VAT (รวมแล้ว)' line -> the repo's established model is VAT-INCLUSIVE prices (VAT embedded in subtotal, not added on top). Kept that model for inclusive lines and ADDED exclusive VAT on top for VAT-exclusive lines (previously exclusive VAT was silently dropped from the payable). cartStore.ts: added pure helper computeLineVats(items, billDiscountRatio) returning per-line { vat, exclusive }; lineNet = item.subtotal * ratio where ratio=(subtotal-discountTotal)/subtotal so sum(lineNet)=subtotal-discountTotal (bill discount spread proportionally). Per line by product.vatIncluded/vatRate: exclusive VAT = lineNet*rate/100; inclusive VAT = lineNet - lineNet/(1+rate/100); rate 0 -> 0. getVatAmount = sum of all per-line vat; getGrandTotal = afterDiscount + sum of EXCLUSIVE vat only (inclusive never double-added). Both guard subtotal<=0 -> returns 0 / afterDiscount. PaymentScreen.tsx: replaced hardcoded 'VAT 7% (รวมแล้ว)' with a useMemo vatLabel — shows 'VAT {rate}% (รวมแล้ว)' only when every taxed line is inclusive at a single rate, otherwise falls back to 'ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม (VAT)' (mixed/exclusive/no-tax). useMemo already imported; no new import. TEST: src/store/__tests__/cartVat.test.ts (5 tests) mocks react-native + @react-native-async-storage/async-storage at top (same workaround as priceResolver.test.ts) because cartStore->persistStorage imports them and they don't resolve under happy-dom. Cases: empty cart=0; mixed inclusive7%(107)+exclusive7%(100)+0%(50) -> getVatAmount 14, getGrandTotal 264; with 10% bill discount -> VAT 12.6, grand 237.6; inclusive-only -> grand==subtotal. VERIFICATION: tsc --noEmit = exactly the 13 baseline errors, NONE in cartStore.ts/PaymentScreen.tsx/cartVat.test.ts; npm test = cartVat 5 + priceResolver 5 + cartAdapter 14 (24 passing across 3 files) + engine self-test 39/0; the 3 pre-existing suite-load failures (engine.test.ts 'no suite', SyncService + branchPermissionStore 'Libraries/Image/Image') remain. NOTE for later steps: any screen/test that sums getVatAmount into a payable must NOT re-add it (grand total already accounts for exclusive VAT); downstream SaleRecord.vatAmount now reflects true per-line VAT instead of flat 7%.
